# Temple Scroll Column 2 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 2 | **Condition:** Heavily damaged; partial lines survive

---

**2:1** [...] I will consecrate [my] temp[le ...]

**2:2** [...] where I will settle my glorious presence [...]

**2:3** [...] the cloud will rest upon it [...] and I will reveal myself to them [...]

**2:4** [...] until the day of new creation, [when] I will build my temple [...]

**2:5** [...] I will establish it as my own for all time [...]

**2:6** [...] in keeping with the covenant I made with Jacob [...]

**2:7** [...] at Bethel [...]

**2:8** [...] covenant [...] I will establish [...]

**2:9** [...] for them [...] a covenant that will last forever [...]

**2:10** [...] I will be their God [...]

**2:11** [...] and they will be my people [...]

**2:12** [...] dwelling in my holy place forever [...]

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 2 presents God's own voice declaring the consecration of the ideal temple and the establishment of an eternal covenant. The "day of creation" (rendered "day of new creation") points to God's eschatological act of building the final temple himself. The covenant formula ("I will be their God... they will be my people") echoes the great prophetic promises of Jeremiah and Ezekiel.*
